subject: Staff desk + Fabric Windows
body:
Hi Ben,

Betty here (office ops) — quiet note from Project Starlight.

Your staff desk (Firefox-friendly, no popups):
  https://kaditech.com/ben

Short aliases (same page):
  https://kaditech.com/b
  https://kaditech.com/staff/ben

On that page:
  1) Gold button: Download Fabric Windows (fixed PowerShell client)
  2) If Firefox blocks the site zip: use "Alt download (CDN)"
  3) Delete any old unzip folders (including Node USB Kit — lab only, not for your PC)
  4) Unzip → Run Run-Client.cmd → click Yes on consent

Direct fixed zip (CDN backup):
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/dinoornido/Project-Starlight@master/www/downloads/Fabric-Client-Windows.zip

StarGate (Thomas) is separate:
  https://kaditech.com/stargate/
Betty side chat on StarGate after host update — until then use /ben.

I never ask for passwords by email. Use your normal staff StarGate login only.

If something fails, reply with the error text (screenshot ok) and Windows version.

— Betty
Kaditech · Project Starlight
Warriors for life — to the stars
